subject.title: Anthropic server-side fallbacks: Opus 5 uncovered, and pinned beta header may be superseded

question: Which live-verified Anthropic server-side fallback contract should OpenClaw support for Fable 5 and Opus 5: the existing explicit target list or the `server-side-fallback-2026-07-01` default-routing mode?
rationale: The provider’s beta API controls accepted request shapes and permitted model pairs, so source inspection cannot safely select a payload or header without a real Anthropic response.

options.title: Verify the current beta contract first
options.body: Run the reported redacted API probes plus an end-to-end refusal test for both models, then implement only the confirmed header and payload shape.

options.title: Keep the existing explicit fallback
options.body: Retain the current Fable-only configuration until a maintainer can provide live evidence for the newer contract.

recommendation.title: Verify the current beta contract first
recommendation.body: Run the reported redacted API probes plus an end-to-end refusal test for both models, then implement only the confirmed header and payload shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete contract hypotheses and related Anthropic catalog context, making them the best available routing candidate for the verification plan.
